_: PAL -> USA addresses in .rdata that app/ reads, for tools/editions/mapa_desde_pgo.py. The PGO profiles only pair functions, and .rdata moves in this edition. Each pair comes from the load the comment next to the constant in app/src names, read in the paired USA function (lis + addi/lfs), and where the comment gives the value, from the value at the USA address. .rdata does not move up to 0x82077C2C; from the row masks on it moves back 0xD0, and near the end 0xC0.

pruebas.8200FCF8: Xbox 360 shader header (0x102A...) at the same address; the same for 8200FE00 and 8200FFC0
pruebas.82040200: 100.0f at the same address, and lfs f31,512(r10) with r10 = 0x82040000 in the USA code
pruebas.82060BBC: 8.7f at the same address and nowhere else within 8 KB
pruebas.82057114: 60.0f at the same address; referenced unmoved from the scenery function
pruebas.82061CE8: referenced unmoved from 5 places in the USA versions of the hooked functions
pruebas.82072490: vtable referenced unmoved; +8 and +0x50 are entries of the same vtable
pruebas.82077C2C: the string GarageMain.fng, the front-end name the code passes, at the same address
pruebas.8208F7C0: lis r10 + addi r7,r10 in USA 82449A98 (PAL 82449C00) points to 8208F6F0
pruebas.820AFD18: lis r11 + lfs f0 in both resamplers (USA 82602FC8, 82619628) loads 820AFC58 = 1/65536
pruebas.820AFD68: lis r11 + lfs f0 in the filter (USA 825CCE90) loads 820AFCA8
pruebas.820AFF50: 1/8192 at 820AFE90, the same 0xC0 as its neighbors
pruebas.820B0000: lis base in a comment (lfs f0,-176(0x820B0000)), moved with its constant
